name: Nighthowler — bestowed, boosts only the enchanted creature once
notes: Memory: project_nighthowler_bestow_and_creature_graveyard_count_2026-06-04. With one creature card in a graveyard (X = 1), Nighthowler bestowed on Grizzly Bears redirects its single self boost to the enchanted creature: Bears 3/3, Nighthowler itself 0/0 (not 1/1), and the unenchanted Giant Spider stays 2/4. A double-counted redirect would make Bears 4/4.
